result: Yes, this is Shelly! A snail is exactly what I wanted for the trail start, and the big spiral shell winding inward echoes our spiral path, which I love. The low, flat body feels slow and calm, too. What bothers me a little is that the body is just a thin line, so it reads more like a shell sitting on a stick than a soft, friendly snail, and the eye stalks at the right are so small and tangled that kids might not spot a face at all.
